app.tagline: Find junk that's safe to remove. Nothing is deleted until you choose to.
clean.title: Clean up
clean.progress: Moving to the Recycle Bin… {0} of {1}
clean.intro: Click Scan to see what can be cleaned. Scanning only looks — nothing is changed.
clean.appRunning: {0} is open — close it to clean this
clean.moreItems: {0} smaller items ({1}) are not listed one by one; they are cleaned together with this category.
clean.note: Selected items go to the Recycle Bin, and you can undo a clean with one click.
clean.done: Moved {0} items ({1}) to the Recycle Bin.
clean.doneSkipped: Moved {0} items ({1}) to the Recycle Bin. {2} were left alone because they changed, are in use, or their app is open.
review.title: Review what will be moved
review.note: Everything below goes to the Recycle Bin. Untick anything you want to keep. Nothing is moved until you confirm, and you can undo it afterwards.
undo.done: Put back {0} items from the Recycle Bin.
undo.partial: Put back {0} items. {1} could not be put back: no longer in the Recycle Bin, or something with the same name is already in its place.
history.desc: The last 5 cleans. Undo puts what was moved back where it was, as long as it is still in the Recycle Bin.
exclude.desc: Scans leave these out, and nothing inside them is ever moved. Add a folder here, or press the lock next to an item on the Clean up page.
exclude.hidden: Left out: {0} on the Never clean list
cat.temp-files.name: Temporary files
cat.temp-files.desc: Files programs leave in your temp folder. Only items untouched for a day are listed; programs create new ones when they need them.
cat.crash-dumps.name: Crash dumps
cat.crash-dumps.desc: Memory snapshots saved when an app crashed. Only useful for investigating that crash.
cat.error-reports.name: Windows error reports
cat.error-reports.desc: Problem reports Windows collected about apps that stopped working. Already sent or no longer needed.
cat.gpu-shader-cache.name: Graphics shader cache
cat.gpu-shader-cache.desc: Shaders Windows and your graphics driver (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) prepared for games and apps. Prepared again the next time they run, so that first start may be a little slower. Only items untouched for a day are listed.
cat.edge-cache.name: Microsoft Edge cache
cat.edge-cache.desc: Pages and images Edge keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.chrome-cache.name: Google Chrome cache
cat.chrome-cache.desc: Pages and images Chrome keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.firefox-cache.name: Mozilla Firefox cache
cat.firefox-cache.desc: Pages and images Firefox keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.brave-cache.name: Brave cache
cat.brave-cache.desc: Pages and images Brave keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.vivaldi-cache.name: Vivaldi cache
cat.vivaldi-cache.desc: Pages and images Vivaldi keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.opera-cache.name: Opera cache
cat.opera-cache.desc: Pages and images Opera keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.yandex-cache.name: Yandex Browser cache
cat.yandex-cache.desc: Pages and images Yandex Browser keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.360-cache.name: 360 Browser cache
cat.360-cache.desc: Pages and images 360 Browser keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.qqbrowser-cache.name: QQ Browser cache
cat.qqbrowser-cache.desc: Pages and images QQ Browser keeps to open sites faster. Rebuilt as you browse; your history, passwords and sign-ins are kept.
cat.wechat-cache.name: WeChat cache
cat.wechat-cache.desc: Temporary files, and pages and images WeChat's built-in browser and mini programs keep. WeChat downloads them again when needed. Chat history is never touched.
cat.wechat-logs.name: WeChat logs
cat.wechat-logs.desc: Log files WeChat writes for troubleshooting.
cat.wechat-media.name: WeChat pictures and videos over 6 months old
cat.wechat-media.desc: Chat pictures and videos, by chat and month (chats show as codes). Chat history stays, but these pictures and videos will no longer open on this PC.
cat.wechat-files.name: Files received in WeChat over 6 months ago
cat.wechat-files.desc: Files received in chats, one by one. Chats still list them, but they must be downloaded again to open, and older ones may no longer be available.
cat.wecom-cache.name: WeCom cache
cat.wecom-cache.desc: Temporary files, and pages and images WeCom's built-in browser and mini programs keep. WeCom downloads them again when needed. Chat history, documents and synced files are never touched.
cat.wecom-logs.name: WeCom logs
cat.wecom-logs.desc: Log files WeCom writes for troubleshooting.
cat.wecom-media.name: WeCom pictures and videos over 6 months old
cat.wecom-media.desc: Chat pictures and videos, by month. Chat history stays, but these pictures and videos may no longer open on this PC.
cat.wecom-files.name: Files received in WeCom over 6 months ago
cat.wecom-files.desc: Files received in chats, one by one. Chats still list them, but they must be downloaded again to open, and older ones may no longer be available.
cat.qq-cache.name: QQ cache
cat.qq-cache.desc: Pages and images QQ's built-in browser keeps. Rebuilt as needed; chat history and received files are never touched.
cat.dingtalk-cache.name: DingTalk cache
cat.dingtalk-cache.desc: Pages and images DingTalk's built-in browser keeps. Rebuilt as needed; chat history and received files are never touched.
cat.feishu-cache.name: Feishu / Lark cache
cat.feishu-cache.desc: Pages and images Feishu / Lark's built-in browser keeps. Rebuilt as needed; chat history and received files are never touched.
cat.npm-cache.name: npm cache
cat.npm-cache.desc: Packages npm downloaded before. Downloaded again when a project needs them.
cat.pip-cache.name: pip cache
cat.pip-cache.desc: Python packages pip downloaded before. Downloaded again when needed.
cat.nuget-cache.name: NuGet HTTP cache
cat.nuget-cache.desc: Package lists and downloads NuGet cached. Your projects' installed packages are not touched.
cat.yarn-cache.name: Yarn cache
cat.yarn-cache.desc: Packages Yarn downloaded before. Downloaded again when a project needs them.
cat.gradle-cache.name: Gradle caches
cat.gradle-cache.desc: Dependencies and build caches Gradle downloaded (Android Studio). Downloaded again on the next build.
cat.vscode-cache.name: VS Code caches and logs
cat.vscode-cache.desc: Caches, old logs and crash reports of VS Code, VSCodium and Cursor, and extension downloads they keep. Rebuilt as needed; your settings, extensions and workspaces are not touched.
cat.go-cache.name: Go build cache
cat.go-cache.desc: Compiled packages Go keeps to build faster. Rebuilt on the next build.
cat.cargo-cache.name: Cargo registry cache
cat.cargo-cache.desc: Crates Cargo (Rust) downloaded before, and their unpacked sources. Downloaded again when a project needs them.
cat.steam-cache.name: Steam cache
cat.steam-cache.desc: Pages and images Steam keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; your games, saves and sign-in are kept.
cat.discord-cache.name: Discord cache
cat.discord-cache.desc: Pages and images Discord keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; your sign-in and settings are kept.
cat.slack-cache.name: Slack cache
cat.slack-cache.desc: Pages and images Slack keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; your sign-in and settings are kept.
cat.spotify-cache.name: Spotify cache
cat.spotify-cache.desc: Pages and images Spotify keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; downloaded music, sign-in and settings are kept.
cat.teams-cache.name: Microsoft Teams cache
cat.teams-cache.desc: Pages and images Microsoft Teams keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; your sign-in and settings are kept.
cat.cloudmusic-cache.name: NetEase Cloud Music cache
cat.cloudmusic-cache.desc: Pages and images NetEase Cloud Music keeps to load faster. Rebuilt as needed; downloaded music, sign-in and settings are kept.
cat.download-installers.name: Installers in Downloads
cat.download-installers.desc: Setup files (.exe, .msi, .msix) you downloaded. Not selected by default — keep the ones you still need.
settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindows.desc: Starts quietly in the notification area when you sign in. Nothing is scanned or cleaned until you ask.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running when the window is closed
settings.closeToTray.desc: The icon stays in the notification area. Right-click it and choose Exit to quit.
tray.hint.title: SweeplyForWindows is still running
tray.hint.body: It's in the notification area. Right-click the icon to exit, or change this in Settings.
settings.trayDisplay.desc: Shows one live number instead of the app icon.
settings.trayToolTip: Show details when pointing at the icon
settings.trayToolTip.desc: Download and upload speed, CPU usage and disk writes.
settings.monitorBar.desc: A small bar that stays on top of other windows. Drag it anywhere; right-click it to hide it.
support.title: Support SweeplyForWindows
support.body1: SweeplyForWindows is free and always will be — no ads, no accounts, no data collection.
support.body2: If it saved you some space or some time, you can buy the developer a coffee: WeChat Pay or Alipay in China, PayPal anywhere. Every coffee keeps the project going. Thank you!
support.other: Not in a position to donate? A star on GitHub, a bug report or a translation fix helps just as much.
about.title: About
about.tagline: A small, honest junk cleaner for Windows.
about.privacy: Works offline: no network requests, no analytics, no accounts.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license.
about.issues: Report a problem or suggest an idea
about.translation: Translations other than English and Chinese would love a review from native speakers.
